name: Reverse Eluder--Range Separation Class
definition: On the ambient domain $X=\{x_1,x_2,x_3\}$, let $\mathcal D_{\mathrm{RE}}=\{000,001,011,110\}\subseteq\{0,1\}^{X}$, with bits written in the order $x_1,x_2,x_3$. These four binary functions are all the concepts, and there are no additional coordinates.
comments: Combinatorial eluder dimension is three, whereas projected distinguishing range is two. Together with the existing Eluder--Range Separation Class this refutes both exact universal dominations. These two finite strict examples do not establish affine incomparability or unbounded ratios.
